Very disappointing experience at Brij Albela, Wadala West. The prices are already too high for items like dahi bada and ice cream, but on top of that they even charged an extra ₹6 for a carry bag separately with the food order. featured_reviews.name: Vinod Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been coming here since my very young days and I and my family really like this place. Brij Albela has great selection of Indian sweets and snack items. We especially enjoy their Pani Puri. I personally love the chaat and rabri, yum...You have your items packed for you or you can enjoy them there itself, sitting outside.. This, however, was not possible earlier as Brij Albela did not have seats, you could only eat while standing. Since the installation of seats, Brij Albela is now also a great place to have short and meetings, and while you are at it, have a quick bite as well..
Their prices though are on the higher side, which I honestly do not mind, but still.. And the staff, they really need to improve their attitude towards customers, they sometimes seem arrogant. Guys, because you have a good product, does not give you right to be arrogant about it....
Apart from this, everything is really nice, sweets fresh and snacks tasty, and they maintain cleanliness.
It would be advisable to come here in a cab or use public transportation, because parking here could be a nightmare..
Enjoy....

featured_reviews.name: Priya pokhare
featured_reviews.review_text: Mithais are more than just good packaging and presentation. People may be all impressed with BSS but honestly I was a bit underwhelmed. I have gifted friends and family with their items . But they are overdoing the fusion stuff , which I guess is the point but they are losing their vision. I also think they do not use good quality chocolate for their brittle and fudge. The fudge tastes flat and nothing of chocolate. The only decent thing maybe the chocolate butter cookies . I would like to like them but they need to make it make sense for the price I pay .

featured_reviews.name: Anasuya Roshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had these delivered in Mumbai and brought over to Malaysia within 24hrs. They lasted the entire journey intact and lip smacking good!

I strongly recommend the Cheat Box, Assorted Mithai Box and Kalakand (any flavour of the Kalakand if you can get your hands on some). Bite-sized portions, provided you exercise control, which is impossible I'd say. Their namkeens are addictive, those should come with warning labels. All edibles are have allergens labelled on their packaging; it simplifies matters for those who have restrictive diets.

None of the sweets are overly sweet despite being 'sweets'. I'm not sure how to explain the irony of that sentence, but those who have an indulgent sweet tooth AND a hawk's eye on their calorie intake, you know what I mean.

Always a good experience shopping from you!

featured_reviews.review_text: BSS is extraordinary!! We were introduced to the store thru an equally amazing 5 Senses Tour. We HAD to go back!! The service and the sweets were OFF THE CHARTS!! We even brought our Uber driver in to treat him to their delicious ice cream!!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently ordered from Purshottamm Kandoi Haribhai Damodar Mithaiwala (what a legendary name for a legendary place!) to celebrate the fantastic victory of Mrs. Sheetal Gambhir in the recent BMC elections. As a proud supporter, I wanted something special, authentic, and indulgent to mark the occasion, and this iconic Mumbai sweet shop (since 1952!) delivered beyond expectations. I gave it a perfect 5-star rating on the app, and here’s why it truly deserves every bit of it.
The order included:
•	Vati Dhokla (those fluffy, perfectly steamed yellow cubes with the classic tempering of mustard seeds, curry leaves, and green chilies – soft, spongy, and bursting with tangy flavor)
•	Kothimbir Wadi (fresh, herby coriander-packed slices that were crispy outside and moist inside – a Gujarati classic done to perfection)
•	Healthy Cutlets (surprisingly delicious, packed with nuts and veggies, great texture, and a guilt-free snack option)
•	And the absolute star of the show – Kesar Rasmalai (12 pieces)!
Oh, the Kesar Rasmalai was pure bliss! The spongy chenna balls were soaked just right in thick, creamy, saffron-infused milk – not overly sweet, beautifully aromatic with real kesar strands, and topped with nuts for that premium touch. Each bite melted in the mouth, and the subtle cardamom flavor made it feel luxurious yet comforting. It was hands-down the best rasmalai I’ve had in a long time – fresh, rich, and so delicately balanced.
We enjoyed this delightful spread together at Smartflex Gym (shoutout to the amazing vibe there in Dadar West!), turning our post-workout session into a mini celebration feast. Sharing these treats with friends after a good sweat felt extra rewarding – the savory snacks fueled us perfectly, and the rasmalai was the ultimate sweet victory reward. Everything arrived fresh, well-packaged, and piping hot/cold as needed.
Purshottamm never disappoints with their authentic Gujarati flavors and consistent quality. This order was a complete winner – tasty, hygienic, timely delivery, and full of joy. Highly recommended for any celebration (or just because!). If you’re in Mumbai and craving genuine mithai and farsan, this is the place.
Thank you, Purshottamm, for making our celebration even sweeter! 🏆🍯✨
5/5 stars – will order again and again!
